issues.titleFallback: NVIDIA nForce Chipset DWM Transparency Stutter
issues.descFallback: Legacy NVIDIA nForce chipset detected on Windows 10/11. Desktop Window Manager (DWM) acrylic and transparency effects cause significant GUI stuttering and potential system freezes.

issues.titleFallback: Legacy SiS / VIA / PowerVR GPU (WDDM Incompatibility)
issues.descFallback: Legacy display hardware from SiS, VIA, or PowerVR (Intel GMA 500/600/3600) detected without official WDDM 1.2+ drivers. May cause blue screens or display crash loops under modern Windows 10/11.

remediation.notes: Recommend Microsoft Basic Display Adapter or remaining on Windows 7 / 8.1.

issues.titleFallback: Legacy Intel GMA Graphics (950 / X3100 / G31 / G33)
issues.descFallback: Legacy Intel GMA 950 / X3100 / G31 / G33 detected. Operates via legacy XDDM/WDDM 1.0 fallback drivers, leading to high CPU usage by DWM.exe and unresponsive UI.

issues.titleFallback: Broadcom BCM43xx Wi-Fi DPC Latency & Dropouts
issues.descFallback: Broadcom BCM43xx 802.11 wireless controller detected. Generic Windows 10/11 inbox drivers frequently introduce severe DPC latency spikes, packet loss, or random disconnection.

remediation.notes: Use Broadcom driver version 6.30.223.256 from Microsoft Update Catalog for stable operation.

issues.descFallback: IDT / Sigmatel High Definition Audio Codec detected. Often loses audio output or produces severe crackling after cumulative Windows Updates.

remediation.notes: In Device Manager, update driver manually to 'High Definition Audio Device' (generic Microsoft driver).

issues.titleFallback: AMD Mobile dGPU Switchable Graphics Black Screen
issues.descFallback: Dual-graphics laptop with AMD Radeon mobile GPU detected. ULPS (Ultra Low Power State) and Fast Startup can cause permanent black screen hangs on boot or waking from sleep.

issues.titleFallback: ABNT2 Keyboard Slash & Question Mark Key Mapping
issues.descFallback: On Brazilian ABNT2 keyboards installed on foreign laptop chassis or generic replacements, the '/ ?' key next to Right Shift may fail to produce characters.

issues.titleFallback: AMD Radeon HD 5000 / 6000 Slow Boot Hang (ULPS)
issues.descFallback: AMD Radeon HD 5000 / 6000 TeraScale GPU detected. Enabled ULPS causes a 60-120 second black screen freeze before the Windows logon prompt appears.

issues.titleFallback: Lenovo ACPI Energy Management / Bluetooth Missing
issues.descFallback: Lenovo laptop detected without Lenovo ACPI Virtual Power Controller driver (VPC2004). May cause Bluetooth radio to stay turned off and battery threshold features to be disabled.

remediation.notes: Install Lenovo Energy Management or Vantage ACPI Driver to restore hardware control.

issues.titleFallback: HP Pavilion x360 11 (2014) Intel TXE Driver Issue
issues.descFallback: HP Pavilion x360 11 Bay Trail detected. Missing or incompatible Intel TXE (Trusted Execution Engine) driver leads to severe shutdown delays (3+ minutes) and power button unresponsiveness.

remediation.notes: Install Intel TXE Driver version 1.1.0.1064 to fix system shutdown hang.

issues.descFallback: Intel Wireless-AC 7260/7265/3160/3165 detected. USB selective suspend can cause the Bluetooth sub-device to disconnect entirely after waking from sleep or cold reboot.

remediation.notes: In Device Manager > Bluetooth > Intel Wireless Bluetooth > Power Management, uncheck 'Allow computer to turn off this device'.

issues.titleFallback: Acer Aspire E5-553G Dual-Graphics Incompatibility on Win11
issues.descFallback: Acer Aspire E5-553G with AMD A10-9600P / A12-9700P APU and Radeon R7 M440 discrete graphics detected. Under Windows 11, the AMD dual-graphics driver crashes into THREAD_STUCK_IN_DEVICE_DRIVER BSOD.

remediation.notes: Do not upgrade to Windows 11. Windows 10 22H2 or Windows 10 IoT LTSC 2021 is strongly advised.

issues.titleFallback: HP Laptop with Ralink / MediaTek PCIe Wi-Fi Crash on Win11
issues.descFallback: HP laptop with older Ralink/MediaTek PCIe Wi-Fi (RT3290 / MT7902) detected. Windows 11 kernel generates frequent SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED crashes with netr28x.sys.

remediation.notes: Replace internal PCIe card with Intel AX200/AX210, use a USB Wi-Fi dongle, or remain on Windows 10.
